annotations.title: Enable or disable an edge rule

description: WRITE. Turn one edge rule on a pull zone on or off (reversible — the rule is kept). Get the rule's GUID from bunny_get_pull_zone (EdgeRules[].Guid). bunny.net: POST /pullzone/{pullZoneId}/edgerules/{edgeRuleId}/setEdgeRuleEnabled.

enabled.description: true to enable, false to disable.

name: bunny_set_edge_rule_enabled
title: Enable or disable an edge rule
